envelope.description: Add inReplyTo to Feedback and validate it

body.title: Add inReplyTo to Feedback and validate it
body.summary: Add the optional inReplyTo field to the Feedback type in src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts (AMD-2f27754d4ad00b8e-9) and make validateFeedback in src/workflow/artifact-core/history.ts accept it only as a non-empty string different from the entry's own id, and refuse a reply (an entry with inReplyTo) that carries nested replies. Nothing else about the shape or the stored lines changes.
acceptanceChecks: an entry with inReplyTo set to a non-empty string appends and reads back with the field
inReplyTo equal to the entry's own id, empty, or not a string is refused with HistoryEntryError
a reply that carries nested feedback[] is refused
an entry without inReplyTo validates exactly as before

tests.name: feedback-reply-shape.test.ts: History.validateFeedback accepts inReplyTo as a non-empty string other than its own id and refuses a reply that carries nested replies
